text:
jane: Heads up — planning a quiet-window deploy for console/ui tonight at 22:00 PST. Goal: small UI tweaks + asset bump. I want a quick checklist before we start: who can own CDN invalidation, smoke dashboard checks, and rollback if needed?

leo: I can handle CDN invalidation and monitor edge errors. Will run the purge after canary passes.

morgan: I can do smoke checks on metrics + trace sampling. Want to validate main route render, auth flows, and websocket pings.

anya: hold on on my PR merge, final e2e fixed one flakey test — I'll merge by 20:30 PST. Canary start at ~22:10 then?

jane: perfect. plan: 22:00 deploy to staging (auto), 22:10 start 1% canary, 22:20 ramp to 5% if green, 22:35 full. rollback window until 23:00.

leo: CDN steps (for record):
```bash
# invalidate static assets under new hash prefix
infra cdn purge --paths "/static/sha-*/**" --fast
# confirm with cloudfront invalidation id
```
I'll post invalidation id in thread once done.

morgan: smoke checklist (short):
- Console main load < 350ms
- JS errors <= baseline + 2
- Session start funnel sane
- No new 5xx (api-proxy)
I'll run the dashboard dashboard:console/ui-smoke and a quick `curl` sample: 
```bash
curl -s -I https://console.redwood.ai/ | grep -i cache
```

jane: also enable canary fallback policy to previous build for first 10m. Set traffic=% Canary=5 for ramp. If JS errors spike >2x we cut.

anya: noted. I'll also add a short client-side log flag `window.__DEPLOY_TAG` so we can search logs for the rollout.

deploy-bot: canary-readiness check: git status clean, infra hooks green, smoke tests queued -> READY

leo: when purging, remember to keep `Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate` for the HTML shell. Assets > hashed, no-cache needed.

morgan: quick warmup idea: hit the top assets from a couple of regions to prime edge caches:
```bash
for region in us-west-2 us-east-1 eu-west-1; do
  curl -s "https://d123.edge.redwood.ai/static/sha-.../main.css" --resolve d123.edge.redwood.ai:443:$(dig +short $region.edge.ip) >/dev/null &
done
```
Not perfect but helps first-page latency.

jane: can someone be on pager for 22:00–23:00 window? just in case rollback needed.

leo: I'll be on-call for cdn + rollback. ping me @leo if anything odd. :thumbsup:

anya: I'll be reachable for the first 30m after full rollout.

morgan: I'll watch SLO dashboards and set a short alert slack-hook to #eng-oncall if errors jump.

jane: awesome — final checklist for tonight: merge by 20:30, staging deploy at 22:00, canary 22:10 (1% -> 5%), purge CDN after 5% green, full at 22:35. Rollback criteria: JS errors >2x baseline OR median p95 render > 600ms OR 5xx spike > +1%.

leo: added runbook snippet for rollback: `infra deploy promote --to previous` + `infra cdn purge --cancel <invalidation-id>` if needed.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: Deploy window at 22:00 PST (in 2h).

jane: thanks all. I’ll post a quick post-deploy checkin here once full rolled. Good luck! :rocket:
